d: Act as the single point of contact between District ICT Operations and Corporate IT for all IT/OT network and security matters. The role manages the relationship, coordinates incidents, escalations, changes and requests, and keeps both parties aligned.
q: Managing cross-organizational relationships and building trust with Corporate IT leadership
Calm, structured coordination during incidents and escalations
Clear communication of technical issues, impacts and decisions to mixed audiences
Influence and negotiation without direct authority
Disciplined tracking, follow-through and governance reporting
Corporate IT network, security and operations teams: Primary counterpart for all IT/OT matters
Associate Director and District ICT leadership: Escalations, risks and governance reporting
Major incident, change and L1.5 teams: Incident coordination and change alignment
Design assurance, project and operational readiness teams: Corporate IT dependencies and approvals
Vendors and MSPs: Issues that cross Corporate IT boundaries
10+ years in IT or OT operations, including 4+ years in service or relationship management.
Sound understanding of IT/OT network segmentation, connectivity and cybersecurity principles.
Strong grasp of ITIL 4 incident, change and escalation management practices.
Experience working with OLAs, escalation matrices and governance in multi-party environments.
ITIL 4, CCNP or equivalent required; a cybersecurity awareness certification (e.g. CompTIA Security+) desirable.
r: Single point of contact: Serve as the primary interface with Corporate IT for all IT/OT network and security issues, requests and dependencies.

Incident and escalation coordination: Coordinate incidents involving Corporate IT, including major incidents. Drive timely engagement, clear ownership and resolution, and manage escalations through agreed paths.

Change and dependency coordination: Make sure District ICT changes, projects and design reviews that affect Corporate IT networks or security are raised, coordinated and approved through the right Corporate IT channels.
Security and access requests : Coordinate firewall rules, connectivity, access and security requests with Corporate IT, and track them through to completion.
Engagement model: Define and maintain the operating interface with Corporate IT: contacts, escalation matrix, OLAs, meeting cadence and responsibilities.
Governance and reporting: Run regular service reviews with Corporate IT. Report on open issues, risks, dependencies and performance to the Associate Director.
